author: anon-df5e95db
content: Unlocked by CL-6 (bcf_unpack) + CL-26 (bcf_hdr_id2int). The workhorse: 120-line C function that encodes typed values into the shared binary block's INFO section. Called by push_info_integer, push_info_float, push_info_string, push_info_flag, and all clear_info_* methods. Replacing this makes the entire BCF INFO write pipeline FFI-free. Needs bcf_enc_vint (variable-length integer encoder) and shared-block resize logic.
